races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted Qualifer) (GBB)

runners_data.name: Red Spells Danger
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with best form figures and highest rating, though hasn't won yet despite multiple placings over course and distance.

runners_data.name: Tip Foster
runners_data.note: Promising debutant showed ability when third on soft ground, prominent style suits if handling the faster surface.

runners_data.name: Soda
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who ran well when third over course and distance on similar going last time out.

runners_data.name: Highfield Jewel
runners_data.note: Lightly raced sort returning after 106 days off, uncertain running style makes her hard to assess tactically.

runners_data.name: Rousham
runners_data.note: Prominent racer struggling for form with disappointing recent efforts, trainer's poor strike rate adds concern.

runners_data.name: Sparkling Wine
runners_data.note: Unreliable finisher returning after 387-day absence, likely to need the run despite trainer's decent recent record.

runners_data.name: Ndoto
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form on slower surfaces, 48 days since last run may leave him short of peak fitness.

races.paceDynamic: Red Spells Danger will lead from the gates with Tip Foster and Rousham providing early company, creating a modest gallop over this 6f trip. The lack of genuine early pace means the tempo will be steady rather than searching, allowing hold-up horses to remain in touch throughout. With only seven runners and limited early speed, this sets up as a race where prominent racers and hold-up horses can both be competitive. This tactical scenario favours horses with finishing kick over pure front-runners, as the moderate pace will produce a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Red Spells Danger sets reasonable fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The steady tempo keeps the field together turning for home, producing a cavalry charge finish where class and finishing kick matter most. Red Spells Danger's superior rating and recent form edge gives him the advantage in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is particularly sedate with Red Spells Danger unopposed
scenarios.body: The crawling gallop allows Soda and Ndoto to get into perfect striking positions before unleashing late runs. Both hold-up specialists can exploit the tactical scenario despite their modest ratings.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Control
scenarios.trigger: If Tip Foster and Rousham press Red Spells Danger early to quicken the tempo
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and favours horses racing closer to the speed throughout. Tip Foster can capitalise on his prominent style while the stronger gallop blunts the hold-up horses' finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Tactical Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and creates a messy tactical affair
scenarios.body: The stop-start nature produces an unpredictable finish where any horse with a clean run can capitalise. Highfield Jewel or Rousham could exploit the chaos despite their poor recent form.

watchPoints.text: Red Spells Danger must justify favouritism after five runs without winning despite consistent placed efforts.
Tip Foster faces significant step up from debut third on soft to good ground against more experienced rivals.
Highfield Jewel's 106-day absence and Sara Ender's 0/4 recent record makes her hard to recommend despite light weight.
Sparkling Wine's 387-day layoff suggests this is purely a fitness run for Michael Dods stable.
The pace scenario heavily favours the first three home being Red Spells Danger, Soda and Tip Foster in some order.

races.name: Traditional Family Day Sunday 17th May Handicap

runners_data.name: Miss Mambo
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who should get an easy lead but hasn't won in 21 days off track and poor recent form raises questions

runners_data.name: Masaban
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form including a good 6th last time, should benefit from the likely pace scenario

runners_data.name: Clear Above
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who has been running well in similar company and suits the expected race shape

runners_data.name: Resdev Time
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who will track Miss Mambo but hasn't won yet and may lack the class edge needed here

runners_data.name: Bobbys Pride
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 236-day layoff with concerning fade-in-finish warning, needs the run

runners_data.name: Dalamara
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent form including a recent win, should get the right setup from this tactical position

runners_data.name: Hood Wink
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong recent win and excellent trainer strike-rate, perfectly suited to this pace scenario

runners_data.name: Princess Coco
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor recent form and fade-in-finish concerns, hard to fancy despite low weight

races.paceDynamic: Miss Mambo and Resdev Time will set the early pace from their prominent positions, with Miss Mambo likely to take them along at a steady gallop. The majority of the field are hold-up horses (Masaban, Clear Above, Dalamara, Hood Wink, Bobbys Pride, Princess Coco) who will settle behind the pace-setters. With only two genuine pace angles, the tempo should be moderate rather than fierce, allowing the large hold-up contingent to get into contention. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish well, as they won't be compromised by a searching gallop and can time their challenges late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady and the hold-up brigade get their ideal setup
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo allows the six hold-up runners to get into perfect striking positions, with the better-rated among them able to unleash their finishing kicks. Hood Wink and Masaban benefit most from this patient tactical approach.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Mambo and Resdev Time go too slow early then fade dramatically
scenarios.body: The crawling pace becomes a sprint from the 2f pole, suiting horses with natural speed who can quicken sharply. Miss Mambo might hang on if the pace stays very slow throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Mambo gets an uncontested lead and the hold-up horses leave it too late
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets first run on the field and the hold-up horses find they have too much ground to make up in the straight. Resdev Time could also benefit from tracking the winner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Shootout
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is perfectly even and multiple horses arrive together
scenarios.body: The race becomes a blanket finish where the horse with the best turn of foot wins out. This scenario slightly favours the fresher runners or those with proven finishing kicks.

watchPoints.text: Miss Mambo could get an uncontested lead if she breaks cleanly, making her dangerous despite poor recent form
Hood Wink's recent 8f win suggests he's in good heart and Tim Easterby's excellent strike-rate adds confidence
Bobbys Pride is having his first run for 236 days so watch for market support indicating readiness
The large number of hold-up horses could cause traffic problems in the straight if they all arrive together
Masaban showed good form last time and hold-up style perfectly suits the likely moderate pace

runners_data.name: Betweenthesticks
runners_data.note: In-form prominent runner with back-to-back 5f wins, wears cheekpieces and handles good going well

runners_data.name: Hurt You Never
runners_data.note: Prominent type but recent form over 6f suggests 5f might be too sharp for current ability level

runners_data.name: Impressor
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer wearing cheekpieces who needs strong pace to be effective in sprint distances

runners_data.name: Mark's Choice
runners_data.note: Versatile hold-up runner with recent 5f win, wears cheekpieces and veteran who knows his job

runners_data.name: Wrestling Revenue
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with significant weight advantage but needs everything to fall right from rear

runners_data.name: He's An Angel

races.paceDynamic: Vince L'Amour is the only confirmed front-runner in this 9-runner field, likely to set sustainable fractions without early pressure from the prominent runners Le Beau Garcon, Glory Fighter, and Betweenthesticks. The midfield and hold-up horses (Impressor, Mark's Choice, Wrestling Revenue, He's An Angel) will rely on the pace holding up in the closing stages of this 5-furlong dash. With minimal early pace pressure and several hold-up types needing a strong gallop, this race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can sit close to Vince L'Amour and kick off steady fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Vince L'Amour sets steady fractions without being bustled early
scenarios.body: The prominent trio of Le Beau Garcon, Glory Fighter, and Betweenthesticks can track the lone leader and prove too strong for the hold-up brigade when the tempo lifts. The lack of early pace pressure allows them to conserve energy for a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple horses pressuring Vince L'Amour
scenarios.body: A faster tempo will set up perfectly for the closers, with Impressor and Mark's Choice able to unleash their finishing kicks. Wrestling Revenue's low weight becomes a significant advantage in a truly-run sprint.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Vince L'Amour Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Vince L'Amour gets easy lead fractions and the field fails to organise a challenge
scenarios.body: The Tim Easterby-trained front-runner can dictate terms completely and hold off late challenges. His recent form shows he's capable when getting his own way in front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow with no pressure on Vince L'Amour
scenarios.body: The race becomes a 2-furlong dash where class and instant acceleration matter most. This tactical scenario could unlock any runner with genuine finishing pace regardless of their usual style.

watchPoints.text: Vince L'Amour must be monitored closely in the preliminaries as any signs of over-freshness could see him go too fast early
Watch for Glory Fighter's early positioning as he needs to be handy to utilise his current purple patch of form
Mark's Choice's early race positioning will be crucial given his hold-up style in a race lacking genuine pace
Le Beau Garcon's fitness levels after 221 days off will become apparent in the first two furlongs
The pace through the opening two furlongs will determine whether hold-up horses get their required strong gallop

runners_data.name: Novamay
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner gets uncontested lead after 239-day break, multiple course winner with strong finishing record

races.paceDynamic: Novamay is the sole confirmed front-runner and will lead from the start without early pressure, setting a controlled gallop through the first half of this 6f contest. The prominent runners First Folio, It Just Takes Time, Fortamour and U Sure Do will track closely behind, with the substantial hold-up brigade of Modern Times, Musical Touch, Grant Wood, Charlie Mason, Beyond Borders and Wreck It Ryley settling at the back. With such a large hold-up contingent needing room and luck in running over this short trip, and Novamay getting an uncontested lead to dictate fractions, this race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can sit handy and strike when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled pace scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Novamay sets steady fractions and the hold-up horses struggle for room in the straight
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the leaders while the back markers are still organising. First Folio and It Just Takes Time are perfectly positioned to capitalise on their tracking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong pace scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses press Novamay earlier than expected creating genuine speed
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to produce their finishing kicks. Modern Times and Musical Touch get the pace collapse they need to be effective.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Novamay's uncontested lead proves too valuable and she maintains her kick
scenarios.body: The mare gets away with murder on the front end and has enough left to repel late challengers. Her class edge from multiple wins shows when it matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace meltdown finish
scenarios.trigger: If Novamay stops quickly and the prominent horses also empty leaving a scramble
scenarios.body: The race falls apart completely allowing one of the hold-up horses with the best turn of foot to steal it. Grant Wood or Charlie Mason could emerge from the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Novamay could get away with murder on the front end with no other natural pace in this field
The hold-up horses Modern Times, Musical Touch and Grant Wood need significant luck in running over this short trip
First Folio's 184-day absence could leave her vulnerable late despite the favourable prominent position
U Sure Do drops back to 6f after 7f efforts and needs to show the pace to lay up with the early leaders
Charlie Mason's 7lb claiming allowance makes her competitive if the race sets up for hold-up horses

races.paceDynamic: Garden Oasis leads from the off with no serious pace pressure early, allowing the 11-year-old to dictate comfortable fractions through the first mile. The real battle develops from 3f out when five prominent runners (Glistening Nights, Poet's Dawn, Triple Force, No Knee Never, Velvet Whisper) converge behind the leader, creating significant traffic problems. Hold-up horses like Dawn Of Liberation and Star Cast get strong runs from the back as the pace quickens late over this stamina-testing 1m2f trip. This race shape heavily favours closers and hold-up performers who can avoid the midrace scrimmaging and benefit from the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalize Late
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis sets honest fractions and the prominent runners clash 2-3f out
scenarios.body: The pace collapses as the leaders tire, allowing hold-up horses with clean runs to sweep past tired horses in the final furlong. Dawn Of Liberation and Star Cast benefit most from their patient tactics and finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Rank Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis gets soft early fractions and kicks clear before serious challenges arrive
scenarios.body: The leader maintains enough in reserve to hold off late challengers, with one prominent runner getting through for second. Triple Force or No Knee Never could profit from tracking the winner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong throughout and Garden Oasis weakens 2f out
scenarios.body: One of the prominent pack times their run perfectly to inherit the lead and hold on strongly. Glistening Nights has shown recent improvement and could exploit the tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis sets pedestrian fractions and all prominent runners wait too long
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint with no clear pace advantage, allowing any horse with a turn of foot to capitalize. An outsider like Tiberio Force could sneak through the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Garden Oasis could get very soft early fractions if prominent runners hesitate to take him on early
Traffic jam developing 3f out as five prominent runners (Glistening Nights, Poet's Dawn, Triple Force, No Knee Never, Velvet Whisper) converge simultaneously
Triple Force and Tiberio Force both return from 150+ day breaks which rarely ends well first time back
Dawn Of Liberation and Star Cast positioning crucial - need clear runs when pace quickens 2f out
Tim Easterby running three (Garden Oasis, Poet's Dawn, Jewel Maker) suggests confidence but splits chances

runners_data.name: Heated Moment
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who should get ideal race setup but needs to improve on recent efforts.

runners_data.name: Bradbury
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with best recent RPR of 70, tongue-tie applied and well-positioned if pace collapses.

runners_data.name: Riddikulus

runners_data.name: Vietnorm

races.paceDynamic: Port Darwin and Lady Vanguard are the two confirmed front runners who will contest the early pace, with Port Darwin showing better recent form including a second at this trip. With 8 of 10 runners preferring hold-up tactics, these pace-setters will get an easy lead through the early stages before the field converges. The modest early gallop will set up a sprint finish where horses need to be positioned handy turning for home. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks, as the slow early pace will compromise pure closers who rely on strong gallops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Port Darwin or Lady Vanguard get uncontested fractions and kick clear
scenarios.body: The pace-setter will have too much in reserve after soft sectionals, holding off the late challengers who leave their moves too late. Port Darwin's recent second-place finish and better form profile makes him the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a cavalry charge with multiple closers finishing fast
scenarios.body: The bunched field will produce a blanket finish where the best finisher prevails in a driving finish. Bradbury and Heated Moment have shown the strongest recent form among the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Port Darwin and Lady Vanguard engage in a speed battle early
scenarios.body: The two leaders will weaken each other, setting up perfect conditions for the first wave of closers who can position just behind the pace. This brings Bradbury and the fresher hold-up horses into prime contention.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If one of the longer-priced hold-up horses finds gaps and gets first run
scenarios.body: A horse like Riddikulus or Vietnorm could steal this if positioned perfectly and finding racing room when others are still shuffling for position. The modest pace gives every horse a chance if connections time their move right.

watchPoints.text: Evergreen Emerald returning after 226 days with known finishing problems could be a non-runner in the market.
Port Darwin and Lady Vanguard early in the race - if they go too fast early they'll set it up for closers.
Bradbury with tongue-tie first time and solid recent form could be overpriced given the likely race shape.
The pace in the first half-mile will determine everything - too slow favours the leaders, too fast suits closers.
Several runners returning from breaks including Riddikulus and Vietnorm may need the run fitness-wise.
